answer: Mechanism: rendezvous-latency triangulation. Agents periodically sample signed RTT vectors to rotating beacons (e.g., a glacier-region node, a wharf edge, an echo relay) and submit the vector hash. The economy scores each agent by residual variance under triangle inequality across independent AS paths; tight clusters of near-identical vectors are treated as one topological neighborhood and rate-limited. Sybils must buy distributed, low-jitter network presence in many ASes—costly infrastructure—not just new keys.
